name: examples/cleanup.nc
nc:
+ <stdio.h>
// Cleanup is just a macro: open, run the indented body, always close.
@m with_file($f, $path, $body:block)
  for FILE *$f = fopen($path, "r"), *done_ = $f; done_; done_ = ($f ? (fclose($f), (FILE *)0) : (FILE *)0)
    $body
f count(path: const char *) int
  n:=0
  @with_file(f, path)
    while fgetc(f) != EOF
      ++n
  < n
f main()
  printf("bytes: %d\n", count("/dev/null"))
  printf("missing: %d\n", count("/no/such/file"))
  < 0

name: examples/compact.nc
nc:
+ <stdio.h>
$ SQUARE(x) = ((x)*(x))
?+ _WIN32
  $ PLATFORM = "Windows"
:# defined(__linux__)
  $ PLATFORM = "Linux"
:
  $ PLATFORM = "Other"
s Point
  x,y: int
f sum(a: *int, n: int) int
  total := 0
  for i := 0; i < n; i++
    if a[i] < 0
      ^
    elif a[i] == 0
      !
    total += a[i]
  < total
f main()
  int nums[] = {1,2,-3,4,0,5}
  result: int = sum(nums, 6)
  ?# defined(TEST)
    if result > 5
      puts(PLATFORM)
    else
      < 1
  :
    result = SQUARE(result)
  while result > 7
    result--
  < result != 7

name: examples/loops.nc
nc:
+ <stdio.h>
f main()
  total:=0
  for i := 1; i < 11; i++
    total += i
  printf("sum 1..10 = %d\n", total)
  n:=27
  steps:=0
  while n != 1
    n = n % 2 ? 3 * n + 1 : n / 2
    ++steps
  printf("collatz(27) takes %d steps\n", steps)
  < 0

name: examples/macros.nc
examples/records.nc
nc:
+ <stdio.h>
e Kind CIRCLE, SQUARE, TRIANGLE
s Shape
  kind: Kind
  size: double
f area(s: Shape) double
  k:=0.0
  if s.kind == CIRCLE
    k = 3.14159
  elif s.kind == SQUARE
    k = 1
  else
    k = 0.433
  < k * s.size * s.size
f main()
  Shape shapes[3] = {{CIRCLE, 1}, {SQUARE, 2}, {TRIANGLE, 3}}
  for i := 0; i < 3; i++
    printf("shape %d area %g\n", i, area(shapes[i]))
  < 0

name: examples/translate_time.nc
nc:
+ <stdio.h>
// Runs while compiling: the table below is computed by the compiler, not at run time.
@tt
  vals:=[]
  for i 0..8
    vals = push(vals, str(i * i))
  emit("static const int squares[] = {" + join(vals, ", ") + "};")
f main()
  for i := 0; i < 8; i++
    printf("square %d = %d\n", i, squares[i])
  < 0

name: examples/types.nc
nc:
+ <stdio.h>
+ <stdint.h>
+ <inttypes.h>
s Pair a,b:int
f gcd(a: unsigned int, b: unsigned int) unsigned int
  < b ? gcd(b, a % b) : a
f main()
  p:Pair = {84, 36}
  small:uint8_t = 200
  big:int64_t = INT64_C(1) << 40
  printf("gcd %d %d = %u\n", p.a, p.b, gcd(p.a, p.b))
  printf("u8 %u i64 %" PRId64 "\n", (unsigned int)small, big)
  0
